subject: Re: Kickoff: health equity toolbox for LLM evaluation
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Kaia 50%, Farah 60%, Saoirse 30%, Giannis 40%. Compute is negligible - this is statistical analysis over rating tables, not model training; everything runs on standard CPU quota.

The real work is data logistics. Giannis has both input paths working (equitymedqa_ratings.xlsx and the three csv extracts), but for the platform version the ratings need to live in Corpus as governed tables, not as files someone downloads. His plan: land ratings_independent, ratings_pairwise and ratings_counterfactual as versioned Corpus tables in July, after the window, once the internal-eval pilot tells us what schema tweaks we need. The Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so landing the ratings tables in Corpus during July leaves us clear of it by several weeks.

Also flagging: rating data is human-subjects-adjacent, so I asked Kofi whether the internal pilot needs a privacy review. Awaiting answer, will build the 2-3 week SLA into the plan if yes.

Alina
